from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,os,hashlib,re,importlib.util
from urllib.parse import urlsplit,unquote
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];O=R/'.local/step07-review';E=O/'evidence';C=R/'artifacts/.review-round9-ci';own={}
for line in (R/'.env').read_text().splitlines():
 if line and not line.startswith('#'):k,v=line.split('=',1);own[k]=v
u=urlsplit(own['DATABASE_URL']);assert u.hostname=='127.0.0.1' and u.port==55495
env=os.environ.copy();env['PGPASSWORD']=unquote(u.password);dbs={x['label']:x['database'] for x in map(json.loads,(O/'owned-databases.jsonl').read_text().splitlines())}
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('oracle',O/'zip-oracle.py');oracle=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(oracle)
rows=[]
for mode in ['production','dev']:
 ev=json.loads((C/'.local/step07/browser'/mode/'evidence.json').read_text());root=C/'.local/step07-review/assets'/mode
 for label in ['first','second']:
  build=ev[label];assert re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{64}',build)
  sql='SELECT json_build_object(\'buildId\',b.id,\'projectId\',b."projectId",\'currentBuild\',p."successfulBuildId",\'exportId\',f."exportId",\'manifestSha\',f."manifestSha",\'profileHash\',f."profileHash",\'files\',f.files,\'jobs\',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(\'state\',j.state,\'projectId\',j."projectId")) FROM "StudioJob" j WHERE j."buildId"=b.id)) FROM "Build" b JOIN "FinalExport" f ON f."buildId"=b.id JOIN "Project" p ON p.id=b."projectId" WHERE b.id=\''+build+'\''
  q=subprocess.run(['/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@14/bin/psql','-h','127.0.0.1','-p','55495','-U',unquote(u.username),'-d',dbs['browser_'+mode],'-At','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-c',sql],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True);assert q.returncode==0
  data=json.loads(q.stdout);assert data['projectId']==ev['projectId'] and data['currentBuild']==ev['retired'];assert data['jobs'] and all(j['state']=='COMPLETED' and j['projectId']==ev['projectId'] for j in data['jobs'])
  files=oracle.parse((C/'.local/step07/browser'/mode/(label+'-export.zip')).read_bytes());assert data['manifestSha']==oracle.sha(files['manifest.json']);assert data['profileHash']=='48844001eea07a8cf0da4baf9abb1653b01c38a9405413ed3123df189cf48793'
  assert data['exportId']==oracle.sha(json.dumps({'buildId':build,'manifestSha':data['manifestSha']},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode())
  assert set(data['files'])==set(files)
  for name,meta in data['files'].items():
   assert meta['key']=='objects/'+meta['sha256'] and re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{64}',meta['sha256'])
   assert meta['sha256']==oracle.sha(files[name]) and meta['bytes']==len(files[name])
   assert (root/meta['key']).read_bytes()==files[name]
   assert (root/'builds'/data['exportId']/name).read_bytes()==files[name]
  rows.append(dict(mode=mode,label=label,**data,actualZipAndAll8ImmutableFilesEqual=True))
assert len({r['buildId'] for r in rows})==4 and len({r['exportId'] for r in rows})==4
(E/'latest-db-export-file-links.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(source='50fd6d84197b8c6d222f139a142ab24c918db0db',rows=rows,distinctDatabaseBuildIds=4,distinctDatabaseFinalExportIds=4,distinctContentExportBuildIds=2,interpretation='same deterministic archive content may be shared across isolated modes; each actual DB Build/FinalExport/job/project and all immutable file refs independently verified'),indent=2)+'\n')
print('4 DB Build/FinalExport registrations, jobs/current/8 immutable files match actual downloads;2 content identities')
